doctrine: Follow skill.md. This file is the SINGLE plan authority: campaign design and execution dispatch live here and nowhere else. Every open step has a failable verifier; queue order is binding; plan complete means campaign complete. Generic authority beside retained specialized runtime is failure, not progress. Every migration must move all production callers and delete displaced orchestration, wrappers, fallbacks, compatibility paths, duplicate probes, and parallel authorities in the same gated wave. New shared code must replace existing ownership immediately. Verify numerical behavior, Live Edit behavior where applicable, code reduction, allocations, transfers, peak memory, and processing cost before completion. After every gated step, merge current master into this worktree before starting the next step.

steps.rationale: HOLD LIFTED 2026-08-19: overgo_tightening merged at dca630c8; the sweep resumes against the merged entry points. TimesFM cell landed pre-hold (2dca3199) -- 6 training cells exist, target >= 21. Worklist smallest-first with per-model routes scouted: TabFM classification/regression (no trainable graph in-repo or in the reference tabular set transformer -- typed refusal with failing check, or port the set-transformer backward; note TabFM is an in-context learner, so SGD training contradicts its serving contract and a principled refusal is acceptable), SimpleDiffusion (internal/diffusionimage has a Trainer and a real-checkpoint Muon plan test -- real cell expected), Pocket-TTS, Un-0 (scratch-training follow-up named in the 5-cell sweep), LiveEdit, Unlimited-OCR, Wan2.1-1.3B, then big-vocab device runs with -freeze-lexical (Qwen3.5-4B already holds a typed refusal naming its hybridtrain closure routes), gemma-4-E4B, SenseNova-U1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B-Q8, gemma-4-12B-fp8, Krea-2-Turbo, Bonsai-27B-Q1, RxBrain. Outputs stay claim-shaped (ledger records + committed evidence docs). The seriesforecast pattern is the template: package trainer over optimizer.NewStepper, probe cmd as production consumer and evidence reproducer, consumed dataset slice committed as the grounded shard. OWNER DIRECTIVE 2026-08-19 (archaeology-first): before building any trainer, dig adaptive_new git history for the deleted Go+Muon training code that produced the checkpoint (precedent: Un-0 bootstrap authority recovered at 581a1cef3~1 -- objective, lr, momentum, init policy all ported verbatim; the recovered objective scored the real checkpoint inside the reference shipped loss band, proving identity). A history sweep for the remaining families is running; port recovered semantics, never invent objectives when history has them. ARCHAEOLOGY VERDICT 2026-08-19 (full reference-history sweep, all reachable commits): exactly three sweep families ever had Go+Muon training upstream -- Un-0 (recovered, cell landed), gemma-4-12B unified (STILL LIVE: GPUAlternatingWindowModel in extmodel/training_cuda_windows.go, mixed-window stream lane, MuonBridge, derived LR, tied embedding frozen, real gemma4u-* checkpoints with provenance -- PORT TARGET), and Unlimited-OCR (deepseek_train.go proven CE 2.366->0.589 in 40 steps, demoted to test-only by 2d4e88449; recover at 2d4e88449~1 / 292e55d92~1 -- PORT TARGET). The other seven never had training code in any commit: typed refusals recorded with archaeology evidence (vendor-training-refusals.txt + per-family findings). Verifier now counts cells + unique refused-model markers >= 21 per the owner hold language (cell OR typed refusal); standing 9 + 11 = 20, closing when the OCR and gemma-12B ports land their cells. DEEP-ARCHAEOLOGY CORRECTIONS 2026-08-19: the dispatch table was never a reliable trainability index (TabFM and Un-0 trained through generic lanes while declared unsupported). TabFM refusal SUPERSEDED -- full set-transformer VJP trainer recoverable at reference e66b8f03e; now a recovery port target. gemma-4-E4B refusal withdrawn -- reference HEAD reconciles gemma4 to the gemma4_unified training lane, and overgo serves E4B natively. SenseNova refusal stands with corrected evidence (bounded fm_head probe recoverable at f4ee9ef34). Unlimited-OCR cell LANDED (10 cells) via the mixture-training-graph port at b9e59506: 2.93B params, loss 7.369->5.075, derived lr/momentum. ENDGAME: 10 cells + 8 refusal markers = 18; the gemma-4-12B unified port (covering E4B as a second cell) and the TabFM recovery close the row at exactly 21.
